Noah: Quick live thread to capture follow-ups from today's all-hands on GTM, pipeline, and partners. Keep it short.
Emma: TL;DR: focus next quarter on partner-led deals with ARR > 250k, SMB direct sales for high-velocity motion, and tighten forecasting cadence.
Ravi: Clarify: ARR threshold is firm? what about strategic partners that open a new vertical? @Emma
Emma: It's ARR. Exceptions allowed for strategic partners (lower ARR) if RevOps signs off and partner brings vertical access.
Priya: Partners: we need a short POC checklist (security + joint POV) before committing co-sell resources. I'll share the template here.
Maya: Product update: vertical bundles (private endpoints, enhanced logging) target May release. Impacts partner enablement timelines.
Ethan: Ops update: forecasting snapshot moves to Tuesdays starting next week. Calendar will be updated.
Ava: CS question: onboarding SLA for partner-sourced customers?
Priya: Baseline SLA 30 days, 14 days for partner-prioritized deals. Escalation path for enterprise.
Ravi: Sales action: tag partner-influenced opportunities in SFDC with `partner-sourced` by EOD Wed. RevOps will backfill on open opps.
Noah: Can someone create a one-pager for partner incentives and tagging rules?
Priya: I'll post a short doc by tomorrow and schedule a 30-min partner PM sync next week.
Emma: Exec ask: escalate any deals needing leadership by Friday via #sales-escalations.
deploy-bot: All-hands recording and notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1876549876
Ava: Got it, will update onboarding playbook and post diffs in #customer-success.
Ravi: :thumbsup: Starting tagging now.
Noah: Thanks team. If blockers pop up, @Emma or @Priya.
